issues.description: Label name for the end of the main loop is inconsistent: the problem statement (problem_statement.md) instructs students to mark the end of the main loop with the label `loop_end` (line 22), but the provided reference solution (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm) uses the label `end_loop` (line 17). The template (template_repository/helloWorld.asm) does not contain either label, so students following the problem text will not find a matching label in the solution and may be unsure which label name to use or expect to see. This mismatch creates a clear 1:1 naming inconsistency between the student-facing requirement and the reference implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the expected label name consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fixes: (a) Rename the label in the solution from `end_loop:` to `loop_end:` (change at solution_repository/helloWorld.asm line 17), and add the same `loop_end:` label (or a commented placeholder) into the template (template_repository/helloWorld.asm) near the end of main so students see the expected name; or (b) if `end_loop` is preferred, update the problem statement to request `end_loop` and document that name. Ensure the chosen label is identical in problem_statement.md, template/helloWorld.asm, and solution/helloWorld.asm.
